answer: Lock the quartz before letting anyone cross the bridge. Every identity that wants voting or grading weight must post collateral that unlocks only on a fixed delay, say thirty epochs. An honest operator funds one identity and waits; a sybil rancher opening two hundred fakes pays two hundred deposits and cannot drain them faster than the release schedule. Closing an identity early forfeits its quartz to the treasury, so abandonment costs more than patience. That canyon of time between posting and payout turns a clone army into an expensive lease, pricing forgery before it acts.
